description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Function' which extends 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor'. It provides functionality to format data values using a user-defined PHP function, including constructor and processing methods.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Function
classes.description: A class for formatting data values using a user-defined PHP function within the Image_Graph data preprocessing framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Function data preprocessor with the specified PHP function name.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Processes a value by applying the user-defined PHP function.
